The Untroubled Hand

You breathe out, catch the line of your opponent’s movement with an open hand, and strike while guiding their weight past you.

Rules

Action: Main Action · Attribute: Reason

Target / range / shape: One adjacent creature.

Strike with an empty hand, foot or shoulder. You read balance, not anatomy alone.

- Weak: 3 physical damage. - Standard: 3 physical damage and push 1 square. - Strong: 5 physical damage and push 2 squares.

Duration: Instant. Applied conditions follow their normal duration and decay.

Equipment / acquisition: No item needed unless named above.

---

Tier / minimum level: 1 · DP: 2 · Requirements to learn: Athletics 1

Type: Skill / Attack

Limits: Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.

ID: the-untroubled-hand
